author: Gisling (photograph); sculptor not identified
en: A later commemorative statue of Zu Chongzhi in Tinglin Park, Kunshan, photographed by Gisling in 2011. The sculptor is not identified in the source. This is not a portrait made during Zu Chongzhi's lifetime. The photograph is licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0; the publicly displayed sculpture is reproduced under China's freedom-of-panorama provision.
zh: Gisling 于 2011 年拍摄的昆山亭林公园祖冲之纪念像。来源未注明雕塑作者；这是后世纪念雕塑，并非祖冲之生前肖像。摄影作品采用 CC BY-SA 3.0 许可；公开陈列的雕塑依据中国关于公共场所艺术作品摄影的规定展示。
rightsReview: Photographer Gisling explicitly licenses own photograph CC BY-SA 3.0. Commons description identifies Zu Chongzhi statue in public Tinglin Park. Copyright Law article 24(10) covers photography of public artworks; Commons FoP-China guidance covers permanent 3D sculpture and requires available attribution. No sculptor identified; do not claim sculpture itself is CC licensed or public domain. Visual crop remains unverified.
